what: Split doors covering the screen (two or more door panels) — on open, the center wordmark letters rise in .03s steps (1.2s power4.out) and the wordmark moves from 40% below the screen into place (2.4s expo.inOut), the panels unfold from .4x scale and a position pushed up and down (2.4s expo.inOut), the door photos open from a point at inset(90% 91% 92% 93%) (2.4s power4.inOut) and settle down from 1.3x, and the door buttons rise from 250% below in .3s steps. A hovered door widens to 1.5x and shifts .25em up and to the right (.8s), its photo turns sharp over 1.2s, the other door photos immediately darken to .2, and a small 2:3 window at the center opens over 1.8s expo.out while photos inside the window bloom one every .6s from 0 → 1x, stacking endlessly. On release the window spins randomly within ±15° and closes to a point (1.2s). Pressing a door fades the split doors over .8s while the page behind unfolds from a single center point (inset 50%) over 2.4s expo.inOut
ease: power4.out (letters · buttons) · expo.inOut (wordmark · doors · page unfold) · power4.inOut (door photo opening) · expo.out (center window · blur) · cubic-bezier(.36,.33,0,1) (door widening · photo brightening)

options.target: Back page to unfold on press (css selector) — while the fork door floats, it’s bound to screen height and can’t scroll, it releases once fully unfolded
options.dur: Big motion duration (seconds), default 2.4 — text and buttons take half. At 0 the open and unfold finish instantly
options.cycle: Length of the center window opening and of one photo cycle (seconds), default 1.8 — with n photos, one changes every cycle/n
options.fade: Fade-out length of the split door after pressing (sec), default 0.8
options.tilt: Random angle range (deg) the window swings through as it closes, default 15
options.stack: At or below this width (px), stack the doors vertically and turn off the interaction response, default 767
options.--fx-gap: Gap between doors and at the edges (CSS variable), default 1.5em — phone uses --fx-gap-sm (10px)
options.[data-fx-part=door]: Door (a) — if href is #, opens the page behind it, and if there is an address, goes straight to it
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Dotted panel inside the door (holds the button)
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Door photo panel — first child is the photo
options.[data-fx-part=peek]: Small center window that opens on hover — multiple child photos
options.fx:open: The moment the door is pressed — detail.tl delivers the same timeline (paused) and detail.at (the timeline position at the pressed moment, default .8). The page reveal sits at 0 and the timeline runs from at (the original’s negative position). If the consumer adds its hero entrance relative to at, they run together.
options.fx:done: When the back page is fully unfolded — smooth scrolling is turned back on here
options.fx:closed: When all the branching doors are gone

note: In the original, tapping a door with an address (another city) fetches the next page with swup and plays the same unfolding — the part simply follows the link in that case. The split door makes people wait each time, so for screens opened often like an app, shorten dur or attach it only the first time.
